existing_fixture_limit: crc_shadow_runtime.py deliberately returns at 0x577DB6 and jumps to 0x577F1E; it validates the existing flag leaf and CRC adapter, not the full native Reveal suffix. The single-store design does not emulate or manage Cell or Visionary state. Its acceptance requirement is only to verify that skipping the MapIsClear store resumes at the original next instruction 0x577DB6 and that the unmodified native Reveal body continues to execute in the actual game.
safety_limitations: This is static disassembly of the exact SHA-256-matched executable, not a live game run.
The five direct callee windows were scanned for direct field/CRC references only; indirect calls, virtual targets and transitive callees are not exhausted.
No Windows loader, live game, RA2OL/CnCNet peer, or multiplayer determinism test was performed.
The single-store candidate remains research-only; production still uses the existing eight-site implementation.
